one_line: One top-down take with word-by-word subtitles, a second idea at 0:20, and a pile of finished gifts as the payoff.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 top-down brown cardboard with a round hole, a hand at the edge. Voiceover (transcript): the cutest photo set she made, explained step by step. Subtitles: "הצילומים", "שיצא לי", "והנה אני מסבירה", "לעשות".
q1_hook.why: A superlative claim and a step-by-step promise are said and written together from 0:00 (H4, H6). But the first frame is plain cardboard with one word, and the bee shows only at 0:15, so the viewer must trust the claim (against H2, H1). The first word sits near the bottom (T4).

beats.what: Cardboard with a hole; scissors cut slits in yellow card; subtitles
beats.why: Claim and promise, with the first step already under way

beats.what: Yellow petals folded through the hole; voice says cardboard gives a grip, yellow for bees
beats.why: Each choice gets a reason, which keeps the steps meaningful

beats.what: Antennae drawn; cardboard frame glued; the finished bee face appears at 0:15
beats.why: First look at the result, 15 s in

beats.what: A small child holds the bee board in a yard; phone camera screen; close-up with the face blurred
Laptop screen with a hexagon template; "גלויה", "אבל אני לקחתי את זה למקום קצת אחר"
beats.why: "You can stop here" then a second idea restarts interest

beats.what: Hands glue a printed hexagon tag around a wooden honey dipper
beats.why: Short second make with a clear start and end

beats.what: Finished dipper with tag over a pile of gifts; "ספרו לי מה חשבתם"
beats.why: A heap of finished gifts says the idea scales

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: Voice and subtitle at 0:32: "ספרו לי מה חשבתם". Caption: "תודו שזה הכי מתוק שיש🐝". No question about the viewer's own life, no tag or send ask.
q2_flow.why: A mid-Reel "you can stop here, but I took it somewhere else" re-hooks the viewer and a second idea fills the last 14 s (R3, R5). The first 13 s is one steady take with only hands moving (R1). It stops right after the final question (R1, R4).

q3_cta.what: 0:32 voice (transcript) and subtitle: "ספרו לי מה חשבתם". Caption: "תודו שזה הכי מתוק שיש🐝". No link, code or product.
q3_cta.why: One soft ask, repeated in voice, subtitle and caption (C1, C6). But it asks for a general opinion, not a specific answer from the viewer's own life (C5, R6), and "תודו" nudges agreement. There is nothing to sell, so no conversion step is missing.

q4_shown.what: Hands-only top-down making of a bee-face photo prop 0:00-0:16; a small child holding it in a yard 0:17-0:19, face blurred; a laptop template 0:20-0:23; hands gluing a tag on a honey dipper 0:24-0:29; the finished dipper and a pile of gifts 0:30-0:33.
q4_shown.why: A complete visible process makes it copyable (R3, K4). The result shows only at 0:15 and the child's face is blurred, which respects privacy but dulls the payoff (S5, K8). The screen recording shows how the tag was made, and the pile of gifts proves it is doable in bulk.

q5_edit.what: About 8 shots in 34 s (about 4 s each). The first 13 s is one static top-down take, then straight cuts. Word-by-word subtitles change about every second, key nouns in large purple. Ends on a pile of gifts.
q5_edit.why: One steady take with a new step every few seconds keeps the process clear (R3, E2). Word-by-word subtitles synced to the voice work with sound off (E4, T1). The 13 s opening take has little new except hands (R1). It ends right after the question, with no tail (E8).

q6_topic.what: A Rosh Hashana craft for kindergarten: a bee-face photo prop and a honey-dipper gift tag; it serves gan teachers and parents making holiday gifts.
q6_topic.why: A dated holiday need with two ideas to copy, the second a gift for gan staff that a parent could send to another parent (K7, R5, R7). The tone is cute and warm (K1). It is not for sale, so it informs and entertains without a sales link.

q7_filmed.what: A fixed top-down shot over a white table with hands working, in bright even light; a handheld wide shot in a paved yard of a small child holding the bee board, the phone's camera screen visible; a blurred-face close-up; a pile of gifts.
q7_filmed.why: A fixed top-down view keeps hands and craft in frame for the whole make (F5, S4). Bright light on white makes the yellow pop on a phone (F7). The child is shown wide and with the face blurred (S5).

q8_text.on_screen: Word-by-word subtitles of the voiceover, bold white with a dark outline, about 83 to 90 percent down (two lines at 0:06, 0:18 and 0:28), key nouns in large purple: "הצילומים" (0:00), "לעשות" (0:03), "צהוב" (0:09), "ודבורים" (0:12), "הדבקות" (0:14), "לצלם" (0:17), "גלויה" (0:20), "תבנית" (0:24), "דבק" (0:27). Last: "ספרו לי מה חשבתם" (0:32). No headline card.
q8_text.caption: "תודו שזה הכי מתוק שיש🐝". 10 words in one line, then 5 hashtags (#ליטלהגננת #גןילדים #ילדים #צילום #ראשהשנה). No ask beyond the line itself; no disclosure.
q8_text.why: Subtitling every word makes it readable on mute, and the purple nouns give a keyword scan (T1, T2). But they sit in the bottom 35%, under the platform's caption area (T4, F2), and no headline card names the topic (T3). The caption is a prompt, not a description with searchable words (T7).

weak_points: The first frame is plain cardboard and the bee face appears only at 0:15; subtitles in the bottom 35%; no headline card; a vague opinion ask; the child's face blurred; no product or link.
lumebook_takeaway: Film the making of a personalised gift or wrapping from above in one take on a phone stand, voiceover subtitled word by word, ending on a pile of finished gifts.
not_verified: Music or sound beyond the voiceover. Whether the child is the creator's own. The design tool on the laptop (the transcript says Canva; the screen shows only a design editor). The machine transcript garbles some words, so the burned-in subtitles were used. Correction: at 0:18 the frame shows the phone camera app's interface, so that clip is a screen of a camera view, not a clean shot.
